Note Launcher 1.0.1 requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.

- Settings now appear in Obsidian's settings search and use the declarative settings API.
- Existing launcher buttons, templates, naming patterns, and preferences are preserved.
- Folder and template suggestions use Obsidian's native controls.
- Settings callbacks handle asynchronous saves and report failures.
- CI checks API compatibility, promises, regression tests, and reproducible builds.
- Release assets include GitHub build provenance attestations.
